name: Ghibli
legalEntityNote: Ghibli is treated here as the current professional-cleaning brand. The official site identifies Riello Cleaning Machines S.p.A. as the operating company and says Ghibli & Wirbel adopted the Riello Cleaning Machines company identity in 2025. Wirbel, dealers, importers, contracting sellers and service partners remain separate roles.
headline: Ghibli professional cleaning machines, Riello boundary and buyer checks
description: A source-backed profile of the Ghibli brand, Riello Cleaning Machines operating-company boundary, Riello Group ownership, Italian production, professional portfolio and procurement checks.
metaDescription: Ghibli profile: Riello Cleaning Machines operator, Riello Group ownership, Italian production, vacuums, scrubber dryers and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Ghibli, Riello Cleaning Machines or Riello Group. Company-level production statements do not prove the factory, origin or configuration of every model, component or destination-market unit.
headquarters: Dorno, Pavia, Italy (operating site); registered office in Verona, Italy

ownership.summary: Ghibli is a professional-cleaning brand operated by Riello Cleaning Machines S.p.A. The official history says Riello Industries Group reached 100% ownership of the company in 2021, and the current company page describes Riello Cleaning Machines as part of Riello Group. The 2025 identity change applies to the operating company; it does not erase the Ghibli product brand.
ownership.parentCompany: Riello Cleaning Machines S.p.A. (part of Riello Group)

productPortfolio.name: Professional and industrial vacuums
productPortfolio.positioning: Dry, wet-and-dry and industrial vacuum families address routine through continuous-duty professional applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Confirm dust class, filtration, airflow, hazardous-area rating, recovery material, duty cycle and accessories for the exact model.

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber dryers
productPortfolio.positioning: Walk-behind and ride-on scrubber dryers cover compact interiors through larger commercial and industrial floors.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Compare working width, brush deck, tanks, traction, battery, realistic runtime, squeegee result and gradients.

productPortfolio.name: Sweepers and single-disc machines
productPortfolio.positioning: Sweeping and single-disc platforms extend the range across debris removal, washing, stripping and polishing.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify debris, dust control, surface, pads or brushes, power source, productivity and wear-parts availability.

productPortfolio.name: Carpet, steam and pressure-cleaning equipment
productPortfolio.positioning: Carpet extractors, steam generators and professional pressure washers broaden the brand's indoor-cleaning offer.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify application fit, temperature and pressure, chemical compatibility, electrical standard, attachments and local service.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Riello Cleaning Machines' official production page describes product-specific assembly lines for vacuums, industrial vacuums, single-disc machines, steam generators and scrubber dryers.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company-level production capability at the Dorno operation; it does not establish the origin of every component or model
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the exact machine's legal manufacturer, production site, serial plate, country of origin and declaration of conformity.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The company says it moulds most components used in the machines it assembles and operates automated injection-moulding lines.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company statement about in-house moulding; it is not a claim that every component is made internally
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Ask which tanks, housings, motors, batteries, electronics and other major assemblies in the quoted model are made in-house or externally sourced.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Official technical sheets identify Riello Cleaning Machines' registered office and the Dorno place of manufacturing for named Ghibli models.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Models covered by the cited technical documentation; other products and revisions require their own evidence
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Archive the exact model's current technical sheet, manual, parts list, battery or motor configuration and production label.

marketsChannels.evidence: Ghibli's official site provides dealer, sales-office, contact and service routes for professional customers.
marketsChannels.scope: Published channel framework; authorization, territory, inventory and service capability vary by market
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm the authorized dealer, importer, contracting seller, service territory and escalation path directly with Riello Cleaning Machines.

marketsChannels.evidence: The official company page presents Ghibli as a professional indoor-cleaning brand serving partners with a multi-family equipment range.
marketsChannels.scope: Brand-wide positioning rather than a destination-market availability guarantee
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Lock model code, voltage, battery, accessories, documentation language, delivery lead time and destination compliance in the contract.

marketsChannels.evidence: Riello Cleaning Machines separates the Ghibli brand from the operating company and from the Wirbel product heritage.
marketsChannels.scope: Brand and company identity; transaction and warranty entities can still differ by destination
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Record the brand, legal manufacturer, seller, importer, invoicing entity and warranty provider as separate fields.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Ghibli competes through a broad professional indoor-cleaning portfolio backed by Riello Cleaning Machines' Italian production platform. Buyers should translate company-level capability into model-specific origin, configuration and local-service evidence.
